documents.name: Done-ExceptionRequestSubmitted
documents.content:
Your Eligibility Exception Request has been submitted for approval. You will be notified by email when the review is complete.

If and when you receive approval, you will need to complete your registration online on the regular online Registration Form. A link will be sent to you via email to complete registration.

If you need to change your Exception Request, please do not register again, but contact the Athletic Director.

If you have any questions or issues contact <<RequestingADName>>, Athletic Director for <<RequestingClub>>, at <<Email>>.

Please remember that your Player is NOT allowed to participate in practice, games or meets until the Exception Request has been approved and the regular online Registration Form has been submitted.

A copy of this confirmation statement with the AD's contact information will be emailed to you.

Thank you.

CYO / Camp Howard
